# TECH RWT Discovery

> TECH RWT Discovery (techrawatdiscovery.sbs) is a Hindi science and technology news site. It publishes daily explainers and news analysis on space and ISRO, AI and technology, science research, climate and environment, and India's innovation and deep-tech startups, with an India-focused angle. Articles are written in Hindi/Hinglish and updated daily.

## Main sections
- [Home](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/): Latest articles
- [Science](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/pages/science.html): Science research and discoveries
- [Space](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/pages/space.html): ISRO, NASA, SpaceX and space missions
- [Technology](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/pages/technology.html): AI, chips, quantum, telecom and cybersecurity
- [Environment](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/pages/environment.html): Climate, pollution, monsoon and biodiversity
- [Innovation](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/pages/innovation.html): Indian startups, funding and deep-tech
- [Archive](https://techrawatdiscovery.sbs/archive.html): Full list of all articles
